name: sales_by_customer_state
description: Sales, distinct items, last sale and days idle per customer and state

definition.population: US store sales with a positive quantity
definition.formula: SELECT c.C_FIRST_NAME, COALESCE(NULLIF(a.CA_STATE,''),'(unknown)') AS STATE, COUNT(*) AS SALES, COUNT(DISTINCT m.SS_ITEM_SK) AS ITEMS, MAX(m.SS_SOLD_TIMESTAMP)::DATE AS LAST_SALE, DATEDIFF('day', MAX(m.SS_SOLD_TIMESTAMP), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS DAYS_IDLE FROM TPCDS.PUBLIC.STORE_SALES m LEFT JOIN TPCDS.PUBLIC.CUSTOMER c ON m.SS_CUSTOMER_SK = c.C_CUSTOMER_SK LEFT JOIN TPCDS.PUBLIC.CUSTOMER_ADDRESS a ON c.C_CURRENT_ADDR_SK = a.CA_ADDRESS_SK WHERE a.CA_COUNTRY = 'United States' AND m.SS_QUANTITY > 0 AND m.SS_SOLD_TIMESTAMP >= '2026-03-18' AND m.SS_SOLD_TIMESTAMP < DATEADD(day,1,'2026-06-16') GROUP BY c.C_FIRST_NAME, COALESCE(NULLIF(a.CA_STATE,''),'(unknown)') ORDER BY SALES DESC
